title: Midweek handoff: Wavefront ops checklist and standup notes
content:
Context
- Quick midweek sync focused on the Wavefront panel rollout (UI + telemetry hooks + analytics joins). This doc is a live handoff for the next shift (overnight APAC) and for anyone who can pick up canary checks.

Attendees
- Evelyn Chen (owner)
- Kai Morgan (frontend)
- Luis Alvarez (observability)
- Priya Nair (rollouts / policy)
- Jon Park (SRE on-call)

Agenda
1) Fast metrics snapshot to confirm canary health
2) UI regressions flagged by QA checklist (accessibility + interaction tests)
3) Analytics pipeline join issue (schema drift)
4) Action items & who owns follow-ups

Fast metrics (10:00 UTC sampling)
- Canary traffic: 2.8% of traffic routed to wavefront-panel variant (target 3%)
- Latency: p50=28ms, p95=210ms (small spike vs baseline p95=165ms)
- Error rate: 0.42% of requests returning 500/502 (baseline 0.12%)
- Telemetry ingestion lag (analytics pipeline): 4m average, backfilled events up to 12m; consumer lag trending down after restart at 08:20 UTC.
- User-facing anomaly count (UI instrumentation): 7 unique sessions hit the new error modal; stack traces point to missing i18n key for fr-FR.

Immediate observations (notes to self / triage)
- The p95 latency spike matches a small batch of long image assets being requested by a test harness — appears non-user facing but we should keep an eye.
- 500s cluster around a single backend shard (rb-05) — possibly transient but tracked in JIRA-CORE-4821.
- Analytics schema: observed a rename of "panel_id" -> "panel_identifier" in the joiner; plugin consumer choked and restarted, which caused backlog. Luis rolled a patch to coerce both keys.

Blockers
- QA blocked on a11y failure: keyboard trap in the new flyout (reported by accessibility lab). Frontend can't reproduce in local, needs remote session capture from the failing session. Assigned to Kai.
- Observability: downstream pipeline (kafka-analytics-consumer-2) still shows intermittent consumer OOMs under heavy backfill. Luis to run memory profiling and consider bumping heap or splitting partitions.

Decisions made in meeting
- Canary threshold adjusted: allow up to 0.8% error rate for initial 4 hours given non-user-facing spike, but require rollback if error rate persists > 0.5% after 4 hours.
- Hold off on increasing canary traffic beyond 5% until a11y trap and rb-05 error cluster are cleared.
- Add temporary debug logging on rb-05 for request path and headers (low-volume sampling) — revert after 24h.

Action items (owner, ETA)
- Kai: capture remote session and reproduce keyboard trap; file reproducible steps + PR with fix. ETA: 2027-01-07 EOD. (JIRA-UI-2337)
- Luis: run heap profiler on kafka-analytics-consumer-2, test memory bump, open infra change if needed. ETA: 2027-01-07 morning. (JIRA-OBS-1091)
- Priya: update rollout policy doc to reflect temporary canary threshold and add explicit rollback window. ETA: 2027-01-06 COB. (confluence link above)
- Jon: monitor rb-05 debug logs, contact hardware team if pattern repeats beyond 3 incidents in 2 hours. ETA: ongoing; escalate if hit.
- Evelyn: coordinate with CS to collect the 7 failing session ids and forward to frontend for repro; also follow up with QA on a11y lab schedule. ETA: 2027-01-07 morning.

Follow-ups / checklist for next shift
- Verify canary traffic remains between 2–5% and that the error rate stays <= 0.5% (check every 30m).
- Confirm analytics lag returns to <2m after backlog drain.
- Validate that the i18n fallback is deployed or that missing key is restored for fr-FR sessions.
- If rb-05 errors exceed threshold, flip canary to fallback model (policy: immediate partial rollback to stable-panel v3.2.1).

Notes for playbook / runbook update (TODOs)
- Add a troubleshooting subsection for "Analytics join schema drift" with quick fixes: 1) apply coercion patch, 2) restart consumer group, 3) monitor backfill.
- Add an instrumentation test to CI that runs a light-weight a11y keyboard traversal on critical flyouts (catch traps early).

Misc / quick wins
- Kai found a small CSS regression that caused a 1px overflow in the flyout on macOS Safari — simple fix landed in PR referenced above and should reduce visual flakiness in QA.
- Luis re-routed the backfill to a spare consumer to accelerate backlog drain; visible improvement in lag.

Slack / comms to send after meeting
- Short note to #console-rollouts with current status, the temporary canary threshold, and expected follow-up times (Evelyn to post).
- Ping to #sre-oncall if rb-05 errors exceed 3 incidents in 2 hours (Jon).

Open questions
- Is the localization pipeline out-of-sync? Where did the fr-FR key drop happen — is it an upstream export or missed extraction? (Priya + i18n infra)
- Should we automate the canary threshold tweak for non-user-facing spikes? (ops design question)

Closing (quick log)
- Next sync: ad-hoc if any escalation; otherwise weekly rollout review on Friday.
- If you pick this up overnight, follow the checklist under "Follow-ups" and update this doc with any changes.

——
